title: Fenced Yard + EV Charger | 5 Min BNA
description:
Stay 5 minutes from BNA and about 15 minutes from Broadway in this cozy 3BR bungalow for up to 8. The private fenced yard—one of guests’ favorite features—has a covered patio, fire pit, gas grill, and outdoor games. Inside: a fully stocked kitchen, fast fiber Wi‑Fi, smart TVs, workspace, washer/dryer, and family essentials, and child friendly. Walk to Seven Oaks Park for tennis, pickleball, disc golf, and a playground. Pet-friendly, with parking for 4 cars.

The space
LAYOUT & SLEEPING
• Bedroom 1: twin bed and blackout curtains
• Bedroom 2: queen bed, TV and blackout curtains
• Bedroom 3: queen bed, TV and blackout curtains
• Living room: queen sleeper sofa
• Queen air mattress available
• 1 full bath with tub/shower + 1 half bath

INDOORS
Fully stocked kitchen with stove/oven, microwave, dishwasher, air fryer, drip coffee maker and Keurig; coffee and tea provided. Fiber Wi‑Fi, dedicated workspace, smart TVs, gas fireplace, board games, washer/dryer and laundry supplies.

OUTDOORS & PARKING
Private fenced yard, covered patio, deck, gas grill, fire pit, outdoor games and driveway parking for up to 4 cars. Front porch with swing and rocking chair.

NEARBY (drive times vary with traffic)
• BNA: about 5 minutes (2.4 mi)
• Nashville Zoo: about 10 minutes (2.6 mi)
• Broadway, Music City Center, Ryman and Nissan Stadium: about 15 minutes
• Opry Mills: about 10 minutes
• GEODIS Park: about 10 minutes
• Vanderbilt Medical Center: about 15–20 minutes

Smart-lock self check-in. Linens, towels and essentials provided.

Guest access
There is 24/7 access with a smart lock. We are always available if you need anything!

Other things to note
A queen air mattress, pack ’n play and highchair are available.

The pet fee is $100 per pet, per stay. Please include pets on the reservation; up to 2 pets are allowed. For stays of 28 nights or more, contact us before booking to confirm the long-stay pet fee.

Early check-in or late checkout may be available for $75, subject to the cleaning schedule.

Guests who live locally should contact us before booking and briefly explain the purpose of their stay.
